news_items.headline: MLB qualifying offer for free agents rises to $23.15M, up 5.1% from last year
news_items.description: The price of a qualifying offer for this year's major league free agents rose 5.1% to $23.15 million from $22,025,000.

news_items.headline: Athletics hire Taylor Smith as president of baseball operations
news_items.description: The Athletics have hired Taylor Smith as its president of baseball operations as the team heads into its final year in West Sacramento, CA and heads to Las Vegas in 2028.

news_items.headline: Orioles name ex-Cubs front office executive Banner as new GM
news_items.description: The Baltimore Orioles have hired Jared Banner, former Cubs assistant GM, as the team's new general manager overseeing player development, coaching and performance.
